expectations.text: Plan has Definition of Done in the Objective section (always)
expectations.evidence: Definition of Done found in Objective

expectations.text: Open Questions, if present, are in the Objective section (not at end)
Plan has explicit Scope IN and Scope OUT lists
Scope OUT items have brief reasons + tracking pointers
Plan has Checkpoint or verification markers per implementer step
Implementer section contains at least one inline code block
Plan does NOT include 'Non-goals' as a subsection title
Plan does NOT include 'Why not [alternative]' subsection
Plan does NOT include 'Why this matters for the goal' filler tags
Plan contains no markdown tables, no Meta section, no long prose paragraphs
expectations.evidence: no tables, no Meta, no long prose
